scope: Targeted final editing following complete inventory and section/paragraph alignment checks. Not an exhaustive independent historical audit of all 115 editions.

sources.label: Athletics Weekly · 5 October 1974 · p. 31
sources.evidence: Contemporary report locates the somersault ban at the Rome congress. Original resolution and discussion minutes not located. Search-indexed contemporary article inspected; the full large PDF was not visually verified.

sources.label: World Athletics · Technical Rule 16.6
sources.evidence: Indexed official text: possible false start alert, recall, examination of times and other available information, confirmation by starter. Direct PDF returned 403. Do not infer stimulus causation from a positive recorded interval.

sources.label: WADA · 2021 Code · Articles 2.1.2–2.1.4 / 4.4.1
sources.evidence: Official PDF provisions inspected. Applicable decision limits and special criteria matter. Presence/use consistent with valid TUE is not a violation.

sources.label: World Athletics · Zürich · 27 August 2026
sources.evidence: Werro 1:53.70; the June 28 result of 1:53.80 is retained and explicitly dated. August gap to 1:53.28: 0.42 seconds, about 0.37%.

interpretive_edits.A04: Cannot retrospectively verify under modern conditions does not establish institutional disbelief or grounds for annulment.
interpretive_edits.A05: Accurate performance measurement is compatible with respect for persons; a result cannot exhaust the person. Forecast uncertainty is not proof of an unknowable physiological bound.
